content.value_statement: Marketing teams need images that fit channels, brands, and performance goals. This skill guides prompts, tool choices, dimensions, mockups, and optimization.
actual_capabilities: Chooses AI generation, AI editing, design tools, screenshots, stock photos, or optimization based on image goals.
Compares Gemini, Flux, Ideogram, GPT Image, Midjourney, Recraft, and Stable Diffusion for marketing use.
Provides structured prompts with subject, setting, style, lighting, composition, and technical specs.
Lists common platform dimensions for social graphics, profile banners, listings, and OG images.
Guides product mockup workflows that use real screenshots instead of hallucinated UI.
Recommends WebP, AVIF, fallback formats, compression, lazy loading, and metadata for web images.
limitations: Does not generate image files without an available image model, design tool, or user-provided workflow.
Cannot guarantee exact brand, logo, or text rendering from generative models.
Requires user review before publishing images with product UI, people, claims, or regulated content.
Paid ad creative and app store screenshot strategy are delegated to related skills.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Dynamic OG Images
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the image skill to design a repeatable OG image system for [site]. Include template data, dimensions, metadata, and optimization checks.

best_practices: Start with the placement and dimensions before selecting a model or design tool.
Use real screenshots for product UI and apply AI only to context, backgrounds, or supporting visuals.
Optimize every final asset for format, file size, loading behavior, and alt text.
anti_patterns: Using AI to invent product interfaces that must match the real application.
Requesting long text, logos, or legal claims directly inside generated images.
Publishing large uncompressed images without explicit dimensions or responsive formats.

faq.question: Can this skill generate images directly?
faq.answer: It can guide prompts and workflows. Actual generation depends on available tools, model access, and user approval.

faq.question: Which image models does it compare?
faq.answer: It compares Gemini Image, Flux, Ideogram, GPT Image, Midjourney, Recraft, and Stable Diffusion for marketing tasks.

faq.question: Does it support product screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends capturing real screenshots and using mockups, annotations, or overlays instead of generated UI.

faq.question: What dimensions does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers common blog, OG, social, profile banner, and marketplace listing sizes.

faq.question: Can it help with image performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends formats, compression, lazy loading, explicit dimensions, CDNs, and alt text.

faq.question: When should I use a related skill?
faq.answer: Use ad-creative for paid ads, video for video production, and ASO for app store screenshot strategy.
